evidence: Smallest submission satisfying the brief (skill quality-checks.md:33-35): instruction.md:1-5 asks for a playground to edit, format, multi-caret edit and run JavaScript/HTML and keep versions, and states 'there is no starter app to finish'. The agent image ships only an empty git repo in /app (environment/Dockerfile:16-23) and seed_data.json has "snippets": [], so there is nothing to tweak. The notes make a stub, static page, mock or single CRUD screen non-conforming: ui.md:3 forbids textarea/input/contenteditable and every ready-made editor as the document surface, so caret, selection, multi-caret, undo, find/replace, colouring and formatting (ui.md:5-15) must be built; behaviour.md:3-7 requires isolated execution with one-based error lines, a five-second budget, Stop cancelling pending timers/Promises and last-good restore; behaviour.md:9-13 and integration.md:7-9 require SQLite records with revisions, stale-save refusal, live cross-tab refresh, idempotent restore and restart survival; security.md:3-5 requires a network-less preview and refused dynamic evaluation. The reward enforces it: scoring.toml:1-11 (identical to the template) zeroes the reward unless both gates pass and functional exceeds 0.05 (score.py:41-48). The render gate needs real typing in the editor (gates/render/judge.toml:23); the constraints gate rejects a textarea/contenteditable, 'including a transparent one layered over a highlighted copy', and ready-made editors (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23), and needs a saved record read back after browser storage is cleared (gates/constraints/judge.toml:32), which excludes a localStorage mock. Functional is 42 binary criteria, total weight 58.5, largest single weight 2.0, so the floor (2.925 weight) needs at least two working behaviours and full credit needs editor, runtime and persistence together; negatives carry working controls (e.g. functional/judge.toml:209, 308, 317, 335). The golden is about 2,000 source lines (src/custom-editor.js 1284, src/runtime.ts 406, src/app.tsx 175, server.js 171), consistent with real build work. Broken app tried: static shell or nop gets 0 at the gates; a transparent-textarea overlay with localStorage gets 0 at constraints. Conforming alternative tried: a canvas or SVG editor with a small hidden input for keys is accepted by gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 and app_context.md:28. Supplementary measurement, earlier candidate only (raw-evidence-index.json observation 2, hashes verified): nop 0, Oracle 0.9833; no configured judge run exists for these bytes and none is claimed here. Observation, not a defect of this row: an app that passes both gates and three functional criteria keeps whatever polish and visual credit it earns (template weights 0.2 + 0.2), but reaching that point already needs a hand-built editor surface and server-backed saving, so it is not a stub.
